Command palette for app navigation

Source: R/command-palette.R
shad_command_palette.Rd

The ⌘K / Ctrl+K pattern: a modal, searchable list of everything the app can do. A thin shape over shad_command() that takes its items as data, opens on the hotkey (or from shad_command_trigger(), or from the server), and reports every activation.

Usage

shad_command_palette(
  inputId,
  items = NULL,
  ...,
  hotkey = "mod+k",
  placeholder = "Type a command or search...",
  empty_text = "No results found.",
  class = NULL
)

shad_command_trigger(
  id,
  label = "Search...",
  icon = "search",
  shortcut = "\u2318K",
  variant = "outline",
  size = "sm",
  class = NULL,
  ...
)

shad_command_open(id, session = shiny::getDefaultReactiveDomain())

shad_command_close(id, session = shiny::getDefaultReactiveDomain())

Arguments

inputId

Input id.

items

The commands. Either a named character vector (c(Home = "home") — names are labels, values are what you observe), a named list of such vectors (each name becomes a group heading, separated), or a list of shad_command_item() / shad_command_group() tags for full control. List entries may also be lists carrying value, label, icon, shortcut, keywords, disabled.

...

Extra content appended after items.

hotkey

Key that opens the palette, e.g. "mod+k" (default; ⌘K on macOS, Ctrl+K elsewhere). NULL for no hotkey — open it from a trigger or the server instead.

placeholder

Search-input placeholder.

empty_text

Text shown when nothing matches.

class

Extra CSS classes.

id

The palette's input id. In a module, namespace it yourself with ns() — this is a UI-side attribute, not a server message.

label

Trigger text.

icon

Leading icon name or tag.

shortcut

Hint shown at the end of the trigger, e.g. "⌘K". NULL for none.

variant, size

Passed to shad_button().

session

The Shiny session.

Value

A command tag, hidden until opened.

Details

Read selections from input$<inputId>_event, a list of value and nonce. input$<inputId> also holds the last value, but Shiny drops a repeat of the same value — which is wrong for navigation, where choosing "Settings" twice has to work twice. The _event input fires every time.

Refresh the items from the server with update_shad_command() — a recent-docs list, search results, whatever the session knows.

See also

shad_command(), shad_command_trigger(), update_shad_command()

Other shadshiny tier-3 components: shad_accordion(), shad_alert_dialog(), shad_carousel(), shad_collapsible(), shad_command(), shad_context_menu(), shad_dialog(), shad_drawer(), shad_dropdown_menu(), shad_hover_card(), shad_menu_parts, shad_menubar(), shad_message_scroller(), shad_navigation_menu(), shad_pagination(), shad_popover(), shad_resizable(), shad_scroll_area(), shad_sheet(), shad_sidebar_layout(), shad_tabs(), shad_tooltip()

Examples

shad_command_palette("palette", items = list(
  "Go to" = c(Dashboard = "dashboard", Reports = "reports"),
  "Actions" = c("New report" = "new")
))
#> <div class="shad-command" data-shad="command" id="palette" data-dialog aria-label="Command palette" data-hotkey="mod+k">
#>   <div class="shad-command__header">
#>     <svg class="shad-command__search-icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="11" cy="11" r="8"/><path d="m21 21-4.3-4.3"/></svg>
#>     <input class="shad-command__input" type="text" placeholder="Type a command or search..." aria-label="Search commands"/>
#>   </div>
#>   <div class="shad-command__list">
#>     <div class="shad-command__empty">No results found.</div>
#>     <div class="shad-command__group">
#>       <div class="shad-command__group-heading">Go to</div>
#>       <button type="button" class="shad-command__item" data-value="dashboard">Dashboard</button>
#>       <button type="button" class="shad-command__item" data-value="reports">Reports</button>
#>     </div>
#>     <div class="shad-command__separator"></div>
#>     <div class="shad-command__group">
#>       <div class="shad-command__group-heading">Actions</div>
#>       <button type="button" class="shad-command__item" data-value="new">New report</button>
#>     </div>
#>   </div>
#> </div>
